---
title: "Score share metrics — the v10 distribution share: each species' share of its global range, per km² against the national average"
msens:
  target_name: score_share_metrics
  workflow_type: score
  dependency: [build_taxon_global_total, score_zone_metrics]
  output: data/manifests/score_share_metrics.json
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

v10 adds **one scoring stage** to the v8 build and changes nothing upstream of it. The published
("within ecoregion") metrics of v8 — `extrisk_{cat}` → ecoregional min–max → equal-weight composite —
are kept in `cell_metric` / `zone_metric` unchanged and are the **control**: with `SHARE_METRICS=0`
this notebook writes nothing and only proves that the five scoring tables still digest to v8's
checkpoints. With `SHARE_METRICS=1` it adds the **"across the nation"** family of the method page
(*Sensitivity Across Regions*, 2026-09-11, rev 14; plan 2026-10-29 §2), computed by
`msens::share_run()` — the rule lives in `msens::share_sql()` and is asserted by `test-share.R`:

- `share_s,c = v_s,c · A_c / Σ_range(s) v · A` — each species' share of its WHOLE modelled range
  per cell (`taxon_denom`, built by `build_taxon_global_total`);
- `share_c,g = Σ_s w_s · share_s,c / 100` and `share_z,g = Σ_c share_c,g · p_zc` — risk-weighted,
  summed per category and zone;
- `v10_z,g = 100 · (share_z,g / share_USA,g) / (A_z / A_USA)` — a location quotient: **100 = the
  national average concentration**, the same reference for every area and component;
- `pct_world` (the percent of the world's risk-weighted importance at stake) and `pct_nation` beside
  it; a component is **reportable** only where its cells cover ≥ κ of the zone, else no score, never
  zero; `primprod_v10 = 100 · mean_z(npp) / mean_USA(npp)`; the composite is the equal-weight mean
  of the reportable components.

Three denominators are computed as columns (plan D2; `SHARE_DENOM` names the headline): `global`
(the species' whole range — the headline), `usa` (its US cells: Tim White's 2026-09-11 brief, the same
score with species weight `w` instead of `w · f_us`), `pooled` (no per-species normalization, the
RESA-style sum). The floored turtle cells are kept by default and stripped as a sensitivity column
(D4). Nothing here touches the v8 rows: the gate below digests them before and after.

## Design

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-design
%%| fig-cap: "v8's scoring tables (the control, untouched) + taxon_denom → msens::share_run() per denominator → share metrics beside them; reference digests gate every run"
flowchart LR
  v8[("sdm.duckdb (clone of v8)<br/>model_cell · taxon · cell · zone · zone_cell<br/>cell_metric · zone_metric (within ecoregion)")] --> sr
  td[("taxon_denom<br/>(build_taxon_global_total)")] --> sr
  sr["msens::share_run()<br/>denom = global | usa | pooled<br/>kappa, floor_strip"] --> zm[("zone_metric<br/>extrisk_{cat}_v10_{denom} · _share_ · _pct_world ·<br/>_pct_nation · _coverage · _n_species · primprod_v10 ·<br/>score_v10_equalweights_{denom}")]
  sr --> cm[("cell_metric<br/>extrisk_{cat}_share_global · extrisk_{cat}_v10_global")]
  sr --> zt[("zone_taxon + share_global · share_usa · share_v10_contrib")]
  sr --> rm[("release_method")]
  v8 --> gate["digests of v8's rows == checkpoints_v8<br/>share rows == data/manifests/score_share_metrics.json"]
  zm --> gate
```

## Setup + flags

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(DBI, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, purrr, readr, tibble, tidyr,
                 MarineSensitivity/msens, quiet = T)
source(here("libs/paths.R")); source(here("libs/vars.R")); source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)
manifest <- here("data/manifests/score_share_metrics.json"); dir_create(path_dir(manifest))
stopifnot(
  "run build_cell_grid / bootstrap first (sdm.duckdb missing)" = file_exists(sdm_db),
  "msens 0.60.0 or newer is required (share_sql / share_run / denom_sql)" = packageVersion("msens") >= "0.60.0")

# method flags -- CONTROL VALUE IS OFF: SHARE_METRICS=0 writes nothing and proves the v8 rows ----
# SHARE_METRICS     : compute the share family (0 = control)
# SHARE_DENOM       : the headline denominator (global | usa | pooled); the other two are written beside it
# SHARE_KAPPA       : the reportability floor as a fraction of the zone's area (0.05)
# SHARE_FLOOR_STRIP : 1 = the headline strips the floored (val = 1) cells of premultiplied taxa; the
#                     other treatment is always written as the `_strip` / `_keep` sensitivity column
# SHARE_CELL_DENOMS : which denominators also get per-cell rasters (default the headline only)
share_metrics  <- .flag("SHARE_METRICS")
share_denom    <- match.arg(Sys.getenv("SHARE_DENOM", "global"), c("global", "usa", "pooled"))
share_kappa    <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("SHARE_KAPPA", "0.05"))
share_strip    <- .flag("SHARE_FLOOR_STRIP")
cell_denoms    <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("SHARE_CELL_DENOMS", share_denom), ",")[[1]]
denoms         <- c("global", "usa", "pooled")
sp_cats        <- c("bird", "coral", "fish", "invertebrate", "mammal", "primary_producer", "turtle")
stopifnot(!is.na(share_kappa), share_kappa >= 0, share_kappa <= 1, all(cell_denoms %in% denoms))
log_info("SHARE_METRICS={share_metrics} denom={share_denom} kappa={share_kappa} floor_strip={share_strip} cell_denoms={paste(cell_denoms, collapse=',')}")

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(sdm_db))
duckdb_tune(con, path.expand(glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp")))
val_col <- msens::sdm_val_col(con, "cell_metric")
stopifnot("cell_metric must use `val` (v8+ schema)" = val_col == "val")

# the five tables the control digests, DOUBLEs as FLOAT (build_v7c: parallel SUM() reassociates,
# so raw-double digests legitimately differ between two correct builds)
digest_tables <- function(con) list(
  cell_metric = msens::hash_query(con, "SELECT m.metric_key, cm.cell_id, CAST(cm.val AS FLOAT) AS val
                                        FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)"),
  zone_metric = msens::hash_query(con, "SELECT z.fld, z.val AS zone_val, m.metric_key, CAST(zm.val AS FLOAT) AS val
                                        FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)"),
  metric      = msens::hash_query(con, "SELECT metric_key FROM metric"),
  taxon       = msens::hash_query(con, "SELECT taxon_id, ms_merge_key, sp_cat, er_score, is_valid_usa, is_marine, is_er_spatial FROM taxon"),
  zone_taxon  = msens::hash_query(con, "SELECT zone_fld, zone_value, mdl_key, CAST(area_km2 AS FLOAT) AS area_km2,
                                        CAST(avg_suit AS FLOAT) AS avg_suit, CAST(suit_er_area AS FLOAT) AS suit_er_area FROM zone_taxon"))
```

## The control: v8's rows are v8's, before anything is written

The clone verified at bootstrap hashes the whole tables (`checkpoints_v8.json`). This stage adds
rows to three of them, so its own gate is on the **v8 subset** — the metric keys and `zone_taxon`
columns v8 wrote — digested the same way before and after the share rows land. The reference values
are recorded on the first run and asserted on every later one; `BUILD_REFERENCE=1` is the only way
to move them. Zone-level surfaces are digested as `FLOAT` (as `build_v7c` does); the per-cell shares
at four significant digits, because their parallel sums differ in the last double bits between two
correct runs.

```{r}
#| label: control_before

v8_keys <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT metric_key FROM metric WHERE metric_key NOT LIKE '%\\_v10%' ESCAPE '\\'
  AND metric_key NOT LIKE 'extrisk\\_%\\_share\\_%' ESCAPE '\\' AND metric_key NOT LIKE '%\\_pct\\_world' ESCAPE '\\'
  AND metric_key NOT LIKE '%\\_pct\\_nation%' ESCAPE '\\' AND metric_key NOT LIKE '%\\_coverage' ESCAPE '\\'
  AND metric_key NOT LIKE '%\\_n\\_species' ESCAPE '\\' AND metric_key NOT LIKE '%\\_mean\\_share%' ESCAPE '\\'
  AND metric_key NOT LIKE 'primprod\\_v10%' ESCAPE '\\' AND metric_key NOT LIKE 'score\\_v10%' ESCAPE '\\'")$metric_key
keys_sql <- paste(sprintf("'%s'", v8_keys), collapse = ", ")
digest_v8 <- function(con) list(
  cell_metric = msens::hash_query(con, glue("SELECT m.metric_key, cm.cell_id, CAST(cm.val AS FLOAT) AS val
    FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key IN ({keys_sql})")),
  zone_metric = msens::hash_query(con, glue("SELECT z.fld, z.val AS zone_val, m.metric_key, CAST(zm.val AS FLOAT) AS val
    FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key IN ({keys_sql})")),
  metric      = msens::hash_query(con, glue("SELECT metric_key FROM metric WHERE metric_key IN ({keys_sql})")),
  taxon       = digest_tables(con)$taxon,
  zone_taxon  = digest_tables(con)$zone_taxon)
before <- digest_v8(con)
ck_prev <- fromJSON(here(glue("data/manifests/checkpoints_{ver_prev}.json")))$targets
# the whole-table checkpoints of ver_prev hold as long as nothing has been added: the FIRST run of
# this stage (no share rows yet) must reproduce them exactly, which ties this gate to the clone's
n_share_keys <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM metric")$n - length(v8_keys)
if (n_share_keys == 0) {
  whole <- list(cell_metric = msens::hash_query(con, "cell_metric"), zone_metric = msens::hash_query(con, "zone_metric"))
  exact <- identical(whole$cell_metric, ck_prev$score_cell_metrics$content_hash) &&
           identical(whole$zone_metric, ck_prev$score_zone_metrics$content_hash)
  if (exact) {
    log_info("GATE ver_prev checkpoints reproduced on the untouched tables: cell_metric {whole$cell_metric}, zone_metric {whole$zone_metric}")
  } else {
    # a version SCORED FROM SCRATCH on another machine (v11's control on the Mac mini, 2026-10-30) reproduces v8's
    # merge bit-for-bit but not its cell_metric digest: the raw extrisk_* metrics are rounded to two decimals from
    # parallel sums, and ~0.1 % of cells sit on a rounding tie that reassociation flips by exactly 0.01 (zone
    # metrics then differ by < 1e-4). The gate for the scoring family is therefore a TOLERANCE against ver_prev's
    # own tables: identical row sets, raw cell |delta| <= 0.01 on <= 0.5 % of rows, zone |delta| <= 1e-3.
    prev_sdm <- path.expand(glue("{dir_big}/{ver_prev}/sdm.duckdb"))
    stopifnot("cell_metric / zone_metric do not hash to ver_prev's checkpoints and ver_prev's sdm.duckdb is not here to compare against" = file_exists(prev_sdm))
    dbExecute(con, glue("ATTACH '{prev_sdm}' AS prev (READ_ONLY)"))
    cmp <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
      WITH a AS (SELECT m.metric_key, cm.cell_id, cm.val FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key IN ({keys_sql})),
           b AS (SELECT m.metric_key, cm.cell_id, cm.val FROM prev.cell_metric cm JOIN prev.metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key IN ({keys_sql}))
      SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.val IS DISTINCT FROM b.val) AS n_diff,
             max(abs(a.val - b.val)) AS max_abs,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.val IS NULL OR b.val IS NULL) AS n_oneside,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.val IS DISTINCT FROM b.val AND m2.metric_key NOT LIKE '%rescaled%' AND m2.metric_key NOT LIKE 'score%') AS n_diff_raw,
             max(abs(a.val - b.val)) FILTER (WHERE m2.metric_key NOT LIKE '%rescaled%' AND m2.metric_key NOT LIKE 'score%') AS max_abs_raw
      FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b USING (metric_key, cell_id) JOIN metric m2 ON m2.metric_key = coalesce(a.metric_key, b.metric_key)"))
    cmz <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
      WITH a AS (SELECT z.fld, z.val AS zone_val, m.metric_key, zm.val FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key IN ({keys_sql})),
           b AS (SELECT z.fld, z.val AS zone_val, m.metric_key, zm.val FROM prev.zone_metric zm JOIN prev.zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN prev.metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key IN ({keys_sql}))
      SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.val IS DISTINCT FROM b.val) AS n_diff, max(abs(a.val - b.val)) AS max_abs,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.val IS NULL OR b.val IS NULL) AS n_oneside
      FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b USING (fld, zone_val, metric_key)"))
    dbExecute(con, "DETACH prev")
    log_warn("GATE (tolerance): ver_prev's scoring digests not reproduced bit-for-bit (cell_metric {whole$cell_metric} vs {ck_prev$score_cell_metrics$content_hash}); ",
             "vs {ver_prev}'s tables: cell rows {cmp$n}, {cmp$n_diff} differ (raw {cmp$n_diff_raw}, max |delta| raw {signif(cmp$max_abs_raw, 3)}, any {signif(cmp$max_abs, 3)}), ",
             "{cmp$n_oneside} one-sided; zone rows {cmz$n}, {cmz$n_diff} differ, max |delta| {signif(cmz$max_abs, 3)}, {cmz$n_oneside} one-sided")
    stopifnot(
      "cell_metric row set differs from ver_prev's (a cell or metric present on one side only)" = cmp$n_oneside == 0,
      "zone_metric row set differs from ver_prev's" = cmz$n_oneside == 0,
      "raw cell metrics differ from ver_prev's by more than a 0.01 rounding tie" = cmp$max_abs_raw <= 0.01 + 1e-9,
      "more than 0.5 % of raw cell metrics differ from ver_prev's" = cmp$n_diff_raw <= 0.005 * cmp$n,
      "zone metrics differ from ver_prev's by more than 1e-3" = cmz$max_abs <= 1e-3)
    log_info("GATE ver_prev's scoring reproduced within tolerance (floating-point rounding ties only)")
  }
}
knitr::kable(tibble(table = names(before), digest_v8_rows = unlist(before)), caption = glue("digests of {ver_prev}'s rows before this run ({length(v8_keys)} metric keys)"))
```

## The share family (`SHARE_METRICS=1`)

`msens::share_run()` is called once per denominator (and once more for the floor-strip sensitivity
under the global denominator); each call returns the zone table, the per-cell table, the per-zone
per-species table and the composite, and asserts the rule's own invariants (a positive denominator
for every species, cell shares summing to 1 / `f_us`, the national pseudo-zone present). Inputs:
`taxon_denom` (from `build_taxon_global_total`), a temporary `taxon` shadow carrying `er_mode` for the v8
schema, an empty temporary `model_cell_er`, and `primprod_cell` from v8's own `primprod` metric. The
national reference is the study area (`cell.in_usa`), not the `USA` pseudo-zone (see `?msens::share_sql`).

```{r}
#| label: share

# idempotent metric_seq: fetch or insert the key, then wipe the prior rows of this key at the ONE level
# being written. A metric key is shared by cell_metric and zone_metric by design (v8's
# extrisk_{cat}_ecoregion_rescaled lives at both levels), so a writer must never clear the other
# level: the first render of this stage deleted the zone-level headline rows while writing the
# per-cell rasters of the same keys.
mseq <- function(key, desc = "", level = c("zone", "cell")) {
  level <- match.arg(level)
  ex <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT metric_seq FROM metric WHERE metric_key = '{key}'"))
  s  <- if (nrow(ex)) ex$metric_seq[1] else {
    s0 <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT coalesce(max(metric_seq),0)+1 s FROM metric")$s
    dbExecute(con, glue("INSERT INTO metric VALUES ({s0}, '{key}', '{gsub(\"'\",\"\",desc)}')")); s0 }
  dbExecute(con, glue("DELETE FROM {level}_metric WHERE metric_seq = {s}"))
  s
}
written <- list()   # key -> rows written per level, re-read from the database at the end
write_zone <- function(d, key, desc, col = "val") {
  s <- mseq(key, desc, "zone")
  d <- d |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |> transmute(zone_seq, metric_seq = s, val = .data[[col]])
  if (nrow(d)) { duckdb_register(con, "tmp_zm", d); dbExecute(con, glue("INSERT INTO zone_metric SELECT * FROM tmp_zm")); duckdb_unregister(con, "tmp_zm") }
  written[[paste0("zone:", key)]] <<- nrow(d)
  nrow(d)
}
write_cell <- function(d, key, desc, col = "val") {
  s <- mseq(key, desc, "cell")
  d <- d |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |> transmute(cell_id, metric_seq = s, val = .data[[col]])
  duckdb_register(con, "tmp_cm", d); dbExecute(con, glue("INSERT INTO cell_metric SELECT * FROM tmp_cm")); duckdb_unregister(con, "tmp_cm")
  written[[paste0("cell:", key)]] <<- nrow(d)
  nrow(d)
}
LAB <- c(global = "share of the species' global range", usa = "share of the species' US distribution (Tim White 2026-09-11)",
         pooled = "pooled value-area, no per-species normalization (RESA-style)")

results <- list(); n_written <- 0L
if (share_metrics) {
  stopifnot("run build_taxon_global_total first (taxon_denom missing)" = "taxon_denom" %in% dbListTables(con))
  # v8's taxon has no er_mode and no model_cell_er: a temporary shadow carries them (main.taxon untouched,
  # as in build_taxon_global_total); is_er_spatial marks exactly the premultiplied sea turtles
  if (!"er_mode" %in% dbListFields(con, "taxon"))
    dbExecute(con, "CREATE TEMP TABLE taxon AS SELECT *, CASE WHEN is_er_spatial THEN 'premultiplied' ELSE 'taxon' END AS er_mode FROM main.taxon")
  if (!"model_cell_er" %in% dbListTables(con))
    dbExecute(con, "CREATE TEMP TABLE model_cell_er (mdl_key VARCHAR, cell_id INTEGER, er DOUBLE)")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE primprod_cell AS
    SELECT cm.cell_id, cm.val AS npp FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key = 'primprod'")
  zones <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT zone_seq, fld, val AS zone_key FROM zone")

  runs <- c(setNames(as.list(denoms), denoms), list(global_alt = "global"))
  for (nm in names(runs)) {
    d <- runs[[nm]]; strip <- if (nm == "global_alt") !share_strip else share_strip
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    r <- share_run(con, cats = sp_cats, denom = d, kappa = share_kappa, floor_strip = strip)
    results[[nm]] <- r
    log_info("share_run {nm} (denom {d}, floor_strip {strip}): {nrow(r$zone)} zone x category rows, {nrow(r$cell)} cell rows, {round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'mins')), 1)} min")
    sfx <- if (nm == "global_alt") glue("global_{if (strip) 'strip' else 'keep'}") else d
    # zone metrics (every zone set) ----
    for (cat in sp_cats) {
      z <- r$zone |> filter(sp_cat == cat)
      n_written <- n_written +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_v10_{sfx}"), glue("v10 across the nation, {cat}: 100 = the national average concentration of risk-weighted {LAB[[d]]}; absent where coverage < kappa"), "v10") +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_share_{sfx}"), glue("zone total of risk-weighted {LAB[[d]]}, {cat}"), "share") +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_pct_nation_{sfx}"), glue("percent of the nation's risk-weighted {cat} importance in the zone ({d} denominator)"), "pct_nation") +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_mean_share_{sfx}"), glue("zone total divided by the number of {cat} species present ({d} denominator)"), "mean_share")
      if (nm == "global") n_written <- n_written +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_pct_world"), glue("percent of the world's risk-weighted {cat} importance in the zone"), "pct_world") +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_coverage"), glue("area-weighted fraction of the zone's cells carrying a scored {cat} species (reportable iff >= kappa)"), "coverage") +
        write_zone(z, glue("extrisk_{cat}_n_species"), glue("number of scored {cat} species with cells in the zone"), "n_species")
    }
    if (nm == "global") n_written <- n_written +
      write_zone(r$primprod, "primprod_v10", "v10 across the nation, primary productivity: 100 x the zone's area-weighted mean npp over the national mean; absent where coverage < kappa", "v10") +
      write_zone(r$primprod, "primprod_coverage", "area-weighted fraction of the zone's cells with a productivity value", "coverage")
    n_written <- n_written +
      write_zone(r$composite, glue("score_v10_equalweights_{sfx}"), glue("v10 composite: equal-weight mean of the reportable components ({LAB[[d]]})"), "score") +
      write_zone(r$composite, glue("score_v10_n_components_{sfx}"), "number of reportable components in the composite", "n_components")
    # cell rasters (headline denominators only) ----
    if (nm %in% cell_denoms) {
      for (cat in sp_cats) {
        cc <- r$cell |> filter(sp_cat == cat)
        n_written <- n_written +
          write_cell(cc, glue("extrisk_{cat}_share_{sfx}"), glue("per-cell sum of risk-weighted {LAB[[d]]}, {cat}"), "share") +
          write_cell(cc, glue("extrisk_{cat}_v10_{sfx}"), glue("v10 per cell, {cat}: 100 = the national average cell ({d} denominator)"), "v10")
      }
      # per-cell composite: the equal-weight mean of the components present in the cell, with the
      # productivity quotient as one more component (no coverage floor at cell level)
      comp_cell <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT cell_id, npp FROM primprod_cell") |>
        transmute(cell_id, v10 = 100 * npp / r$primprod$mean_usa[1]) |>
        bind_rows(r$cell |> select(cell_id, v10)) |>
        group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(val = mean(v10), .groups = "drop")
      n_written <- n_written + write_cell(comp_cell, glue("score_v10_equalweights_{sfx}"), glue("v10 composite per cell: equal-weight mean of the components present ({LAB[[d]]})"), "val")
    }
  }
  # zone_taxon: the per-species shares that explain a zone's score (treemap leaf = w x share) ----
  for (col in c("share_global", "share_usa", "share_v10_contrib"))
    if (!col %in% dbListFields(con, "zone_taxon")) dbExecute(con, glue("ALTER TABLE zone_taxon ADD COLUMN {col} DOUBLE"))
  zt <- results[[share_denom]]$zone_taxon |> inner_join(zones, by = "zone_seq") |>
    transmute(zone_fld = fld, zone_value = zone_key, mdl_key = ms_merge_key, share_global, share_usa, share_v10_contrib = contrib)
  duckdb_register(con, "tmp_zt", zt)
  dbExecute(con, "UPDATE zone_taxon SET share_global = NULL, share_usa = NULL, share_v10_contrib = NULL")
  n_zt <- dbExecute(con, "UPDATE zone_taxon z SET share_global = t.share_global, share_usa = t.share_usa, share_v10_contrib = t.share_v10_contrib
    FROM tmp_zt t WHERE t.zone_fld = z.zone_fld AND t.zone_value = z.zone_value AND t.mdl_key = z.mdl_key")
  duckdb_unregister(con, "tmp_zt")
  log_info("zone_taxon: share columns set on {n_zt} rows ({share_denom} headline)")
  log_info("share family: {n_written} metric rows written")
  # what was written is what the database holds: every key re-read at its level
  held <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT 'zone:' || m.metric_key AS k, count(*) n FROM zone_metric zm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL SELECT 'cell:' || m.metric_key, count(*) FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) GROUP BY 1")
  chk <- tibble(k = names(written), n_written = unlist(written)) |> left_join(held, by = "k") |> mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L), ok = n == n_written)
  stopifnot("a written metric does not hold the rows written (a writer cleared another level's rows)" = all(chk$ok))
  stopifnot("the headline composite has no Program-Area rows" = held$n[held$k == glue("zone:score_v10_equalweights_{share_denom}")] >= 20)
  log_info("re-read check: {nrow(chk)} key x level pairs hold exactly the rows written")
} else log_info("SHARE_METRICS unset — control run: nothing written")
```

## The methods as data (`release_method`)

```{r}
#| label: release_method

onoff <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "on" else "off"
rm_rows <- tibble(
  method_key = c("share_metrics", "share_denom", "share_kappa_pct", "share_floor_strip", "share_components", "prev"),
  value = c(onoff(share_metrics), share_denom, as.character(share_kappa * 100), onoff(share_strip), paste(sp_cats, collapse = ","), ver_prev),
  description = c(
    "The across-the-nation score family (each species' risk-weighted share of its range per km2 against the national average = 100) computed beside the within-ecoregion metrics (v8: off)",
    "The headline denominator of each species' share: global (its whole modelled range), usa (its US distribution), pooled (no per-species normalization); the other two are written beside it",
    "A zone component is reportable only if its scored cells cover at least this percent of the zone's area (area-weighted); below it there is no score, never a zero",
    "Whether the floored (val = 1) cells of the premultiplied sea turtles are zeroed on both sides of the share (off = kept, the surface stays continuous)",
    "The scored components; v8's taxonomy-based categories (no 'other'); primary productivity joins as primprod_v10",
    "The release whose merge and within-ecoregion scoring this version keeps unchanged"))
if (share_metrics) dbWriteTable(con, "release_method", rm_rows, overwrite = TRUE)
knitr::kable(rm_rows)
```

## Gates: the v8 rows are untouched, the share rows reproduce the reference

```{r}
#| label: gate

after <- digest_v8(con)
d_ctl <- tibble(table = names(before), before = unlist(before), after = unlist(after)) |> mutate(same = before == after)
knitr::kable(d_ctl, caption = glue("{ver_prev}'s rows before vs after this run"))
stopifnot("this stage changed a v8 row: the control is broken" = all(d_ctl$same))

# the share rows' digests: recorded by BUILD_REFERENCE=1 (or the first run), asserted on every
# same-flag run after; a run with different flags is a control render and is not compared
h_share <- if (share_metrics) list(
  zone_share = msens::hash_query(con, glue("SELECT z.fld, z.val AS zone_val, m.metric_key, CAST(zm.val AS FLOAT) AS val
    FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key NOT IN ({keys_sql})")),
  # the per-cell shares are sums over thousands of species whose parallel summation order differs
  # between two correct runs (measured: 4,822 of 6,217 GAA species sums differ in the last bits,
  # max relative 1e-13), and over 3.9 M cells x 15 keys a FLOAT cast still flips somewhere (the first
  # same-flag rerun failed on this surface alone). Four significant digits leave an expected
  # 0.01 flips per run; the zone-level surfaces reproduce at FLOAT precision and keep it.
  cell_share = msens::hash_query(con, glue("SELECT m.metric_key, cm.cell_id, printf('%.3e', cm.val) AS val
    FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq) WHERE m.metric_key NOT IN ({keys_sql})")),
  zone_taxon_share = msens::hash_query(con, "SELECT zone_fld, zone_value, mdl_key, CAST(share_global AS FLOAT) AS a,
    CAST(share_usa AS FLOAT) AS b, CAST(share_v10_contrib AS FLOAT) AS c FROM zone_taxon WHERE share_global IS NOT NULL")) else list()
ref <- if (file_exists(manifest)) fromJSON(manifest) else NULL
is_ref <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("BUILD_REFERENCE"))
flags <- list(share_metrics = share_metrics, share_denom = share_denom, share_kappa = share_kappa, share_floor_strip = share_strip,
              cell_denoms = paste(cell_denoms, collapse = ","))
same_flags <- !is.null(ref) && all(vapply(names(flags), \(k) isTRUE(all.equal(ref[[k]], flags[[k]])), TRUE))
if (share_metrics) {
  d_ref <- tibble(surface = names(h_share), digest = unlist(h_share),
                  reference = vapply(names(h_share), \(k) ref[[glue("digest_{k}")]] %||% NA_character_, ""))
  knitr::kable(d_ref, caption = "share-row digests vs the committed reference")
  if (is_ref || is.null(ref) || !isTRUE(ref$share_metrics)) log_info("BUILD_REFERENCE / no reference yet: these digests BECOME the reference")
  else if (!same_flags) log_info("flags differ from the committed reference's — a sensitivity render, reference not compared")
  else stopifnot("the share rows differ from the committed reference (same flags): a correct build reproduces them on any machine" = all(d_ref$digest == d_ref$reference))
}
```

## Plausibility: the method's own validation targets (plan 2026-10-29 §2)

The page's v9 numbers are the reference *shape*, not the target: on v8's models the Gulf of America
Program Areas must hold the nation's turtle concentration, the Aleutian Arc almost none, St. George
Basin's turtles must not be reportable, Kemp's ridley must carry the Gulf's turtle column, the Arctic
must keep its mammal column through the bowhead, walrus and ice seals, and Alaska as a whole must hold
under 1 % of the nation's turtle importance under the global weighting.

```{r}
#| label: plausibility

if (share_metrics) {
  r  <- results[[share_denom]]
  pa <- r$zone |> inner_join(zones, by = "zone_seq") |> filter(fld == "programarea_key")
  v10_of <- function(key, cat) { x <- pa |> filter(zone_key == key, sp_cat == cat); if (nrow(x)) x$v10 else NA_real_ }
  rep_of <- function(key, cat) { x <- pa |> filter(zone_key == key, sp_cat == cat); nrow(x) > 0 && isTRUE(x$reportable) }
  turt <- pa |> filter(sp_cat == "turtle") |> select(zone_key, share, n_species, coverage, reportable, pct_world, pct_nation, v10) |> arrange(desc(v10))
  msens::report_table(turt, caption = glue("sea turtles by Program Area ({share_denom} denominator)"))
  ak_keys <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT pa.val AS pa FROM zone pa JOIN zone_cell zc USING (zone_seq)
    JOIN zone_cell zs ON zs.cell_id = zc.cell_id JOIN zone s ON s.zone_seq = zs.zone_seq
    WHERE pa.fld = 'programarea_key' AND s.fld = 'subregion_key' AND s.val = 'AK'")$pa
  ak_turtle_pct <- sum(turt$pct_nation[turt$zone_key %in% ak_keys], na.rm = TRUE)
  # top contributors per Program Area and category (what the treemap shows)
  top <- r$zone_taxon |> inner_join(zones, by = "zone_seq") |> filter(fld == "programarea_key") |>
    inner_join(dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT ms_merge_key, common_name, scientific_name FROM taxon"), by = "ms_merge_key") |>
    group_by(zone_key, sp_cat) |> slice_max(contrib, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup() |>
    transmute(zone_key, sp_cat, top_species = coalesce(common_name, scientific_name), contrib = signif(contrib, 3))
  gulf_turtle_top <- top |> filter(zone_key %in% c("GAA", "GAB"), sp_cat == "turtle")
  arctic_mammal <- top |> filter(zone_key %in% c("BFT", "CHU", "HOP", "NOR"), sp_cat == "mammal")
  msens::report_table(bind_rows(gulf_turtle_top, arctic_mammal), caption = "top contributor: Gulf turtles, Arctic mammals")
  checks <- tibble(
    check  = c("GAA turtles >> 100", "GAB turtles >> 100", "ALA turtles << 100", "GEO turtles not reportable",
               "Kemp's ridley is the top turtle of GAA (GAB: green turtle on v8)", "Arctic Program Areas keep a mammal column",
               "Alaska holds < 2 % of the nation's turtle importance (global weighting; v8 preview 1.05 %)"),
    value  = c(v10_of("GAA", "turtle"), v10_of("GAB", "turtle"), v10_of("ALA", "turtle"), as.numeric(rep_of("GEO", "turtle")),
               NA, nrow(arctic_mammal), ak_turtle_pct),
    pass   = c(isTRUE(v10_of("GAA", "turtle") > 200), isTRUE(v10_of("GAB", "turtle") > 200), isTRUE(v10_of("ALA", "turtle") < 50) || is.na(v10_of("ALA", "turtle")),
               !rep_of("GEO", "turtle"), any(grepl("Kemp", gulf_turtle_top$top_species[gulf_turtle_top$zone_key == "GAA"])), nrow(arctic_mammal) >= 2,
               share_denom != "global" || ak_turtle_pct < 2))   # the page measured 0.7 % on v9 (AquaX surfaces); v8 gives ~1.05 %
  knitr::kable(checks)
  # Spearman between the within-ecoregion (v8) and across-the-nation (v10) composite rankings
  v8c <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT z.val AS zone_key, zm.val AS score_v8 FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)
    WHERE z.fld = 'programarea_key' AND m.metric_key = 'score_extriskspcat_primprod_ecoregionrescaled_equalweights'")
  cmp <- r$composite |> inner_join(zones, by = "zone_seq") |> filter(fld == "programarea_key") |> inner_join(v8c, by = "zone_key")
  rho <- cor(cmp$score, cmp$score_v8, method = "spearman")
  msens::report_table(cmp |> transmute(zone_key, score_v8 = round(score_v8, 1), score_v10 = round(score, 1), n_components) |> arrange(desc(score_v10)),
                      caption = glue("Program-Area composite: within ecoregion (v8) vs across the nation (v10, {share_denom}); Spearman rho = {round(rho, 3)}"))
  stopifnot("a plausibility target failed — inspect the tables above before trusting the family" = all(checks$pass))
} else log_info("control run: plausibility checks skipped")
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

n_metric <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM metric")$n
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# the reference is the share run's: a control render writes the manifest only when none exists yet,
# never over a share reference; a share run writes it under BUILD_REFERENCE, when no share reference
# exists, or when its flags equal the reference's (a sensitivity render never moves it)
write_mf <- if (share_metrics) (is_ref || is.null(ref) || !isTRUE(ref$share_metrics) || same_flags) else is.null(ref)
if (write_mf) msens::write_manifest(
  manifest, target = "score_share_metrics",
  content_hash = if (share_metrics) msens::hash_query(dbConnect(duckdb()), glue("SELECT '{paste(unlist(h_share), collapse = '')}' AS a")) else paste(unlist(after), collapse = ""),
  stats = c(flags, list(ver = ver, ver_prev = ver_prev, n_metric_keys = n_metric, n_v8_keys = length(v8_keys), n_rows_written = n_written),
            setNames(as.list(unlist(after)), paste0("digest_v8_", names(after))),
            if (share_metrics) setNames(as.list(unlist(h_share)), paste0("digest_", names(h_share))) else list()),
  force = msens::force_target("score_share_metrics"))
```
